vx_av.label: VascX artery/vein (ConvNeXt-V2 + UperNet)
vx_av.members: one network: 9 overlapping 512 tiles of the 1024 image, Gaussian-blended, 4 flips averaged

vx_vessel.label: VascX vessels (ConvNeXt-V2 + UperNet)
vx_vessel.members: one network on the whole 1024 image, 4 flips averaged

vx_disc.label: VascX optic disc (ConvNeXt-V2 + UperNet)
vx_disc.members: one network on the image resized to 512, probabilities upsampled to 1024

vx_fovea.label: VascX fovea (ConvNeXt-V2 + UperNet, heatmap)
vx_fovea.members: one network on the image resized to 512, with a horizontal flip averaged
